default.description: Default IFAO-style plain-text output using ȝ, ʿ and ỉ instead of raised-looking ꜣ, ꜥ and ꞽ forms.

ifao.description: IFAO-style plain-text Egyptological transliteration using ȝ, ʿ and ỉ.
ifao.source: Institut français d’archéologie orientale (IFAO), Polices de caractères and Unicode converters

unicode-canonical.description: Canonical Egyptological Unicode output used by egypttranslit 1.0.x, preserving j and q.

gardiner-1957.description: Unicode/UAX #57 Gardiner 1957 transliteration output for ambiguous ASCII alternatives.
gardiner-1957.source: Unicode UAX #57 revision 7, kEH_FVal transliteration convention

legacy-diacritics.description: Backward-compatible alias for the previous fully-diacritic profile.
